2	// cmd/deploy-worker/main.go
3	//
4	// AutoMESH-Orchestrator – Deployment Worker
5	// -----------------------------------------
6	// This binary is launched as an on-demand Lambda/ container that subscribes to
7	// deployment events (publish/subscribe, SQS, NATS, etc.) and materialises them
8	// as immutable commands.  For every command we pick the best-fit strategy
9	// (blue/green, canary, hot-swap, …) and execute it against the target fleet.
10	//
11	// The code purposefully keeps external dependencies to a minimum; wiring for
12	// concrete brokers (SQS, Kafka, NATS) is hidden behind interfaces, so the same
13	// worker can be re-used in multiple environments without recompilation.
14	package main

42	}

49		}
50		defer f.Close()
51	
52		data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, err
55		}
56	
57		var cfg Config
58		if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}

62			cfg.WorkerPool = 4

68	}

75	type DeployCommand struct {
76		ID           string            `json:"id"`
77		App          string            `json:"app"`
78		Version      string            `json:"version"`
79		Tactic       string            `json:"tactic"` // bluegreen, canary, rolling …
80		TargetGroups []string          `json:"targetGroups"`

85	// Event Broker Abstractions
86	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	
88	// Consumer exposes a minimal pull-based subscription API.
89	//
90	// (Push-based/stream callbacks can be easily adapted internally.)
91	type Consumer interface {
92		Recv(ctx context.Context) (*DeployCommand, AckFunc, error)
93		Close() error
94	}

96	// AckFunc acknowledges or negatively acknowledges processing.
97	//
98	// Implementations usually wrap message brokers’ native ack/nack semantics.
99	type AckFunc func(success bool) error
100	
101	// InMemoryConsumer is a test-double used in CI and unit tests.  Production
102	// deployments replace this with real implementations (Kafka, SQS, NATS,…).
103	type InMemoryConsumer struct {
104		stream chan *DeployCommand
105	}

107	func NewInMemoryConsumer(buf int) *InMemoryConsumer {
108		return &InMemoryConsumer{stream: make(chan *DeployCommand, buf)}
109	}
110	
111	// Recv implements Consumer.
112	func (c *InMemoryConsumer) Recv(ctx context.Context) (*DeployCommand, AckFunc, error) {
113		select {
114		case <-ctx.Done():
115			return nil, nil, ctx.Err()
116		case msg, ok := <-c.stream:
117			if !ok {
118				return nil, nil, io.EOF
119			}
120			ack := func(success bool) error {

141	}

148	func (s *BlueGreenStrategy) Execute(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeployCommand) error {
149		s.logger.Info("starting blue/green deployment", zap.String("app", cmd.App), zap.String("version", cmd.Version))

187	}

193		case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
194		}

196	}

199	type CanaryStrategy struct {
200		logger *zap.Logger
201	}

203	func (s *CanaryStrategy) Execute(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeployCommand) error {
204		s.logger.Info("starting canary deployment", zap.String("app", cmd.App), zap.String("version", cmd.Version))
205	
206		steps := []int{10, 25, 50, 100}
207		for _, pct := range steps {
208			if err := s.shiftTraffic(ctx, cmd, pct); err != nil {
209				return err
210			}
211			if err := s.monitor(ctx, cmd, pct); err != nil {
212				return err
213			}
214		}
215		s.logger.Info("canary deployment finished", zap.String("commandID", cmd.ID))
216		return nil
217	}
218	
219	func (s *CanaryStrategy) shiftTraffic(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeployCommand, pct int) error {
220		s.logger.Info("shifting traffic", zap.Int("percent", pct))
221		select {
222		case <-ctx.Done():
223			return ctx.Err()
224		case <-time.After(800 * time.Millisecond):
225		}
226		return nil
227	}
228	
229	func (s *CanaryStrategy) monitor(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeployCommand, pct int) error {
230		s.logger.Info("monitoring traffic", zap.Int("percent", pct))
231		select {
232		case <-ctx.Done():
233			return ctx.Err()
234		case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
235		}
236		return nil
237	}

239	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
240	// Worker
241	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
242	
243	// Worker fetches DeployCommands from Consumer and executes them with the
244	// strategy that best fits the “tactic” field.
245	type Worker struct {
246		log        *zap.Logger
247		consumer   Consumer
248		strategies map[string]DeploymentStrategy
249	
250		pool int
251		wg   sync.WaitGroup
252	}
253	
254	func NewWorker(log *zap.Logger, consumer Consumer, pool int) *Worker {
255		return &Worker{
256			log:      log,
257			consumer: consumer,
258			pool:     pool,
259			strategies: map[string]DeploymentStrategy{
260				"bluegreen": &BlueGreenStrategy{logger: log},
261				"canary":    &CanaryStrategy{logger: log},
262			},
263		}
264	}
265	
266	func (w *Worker) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
267		w.log.Info("worker started", zap.Int("concurrency", w.pool))
268	
269		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
270		defer cancel()
271	
272		// Fan-out pool
273		for i := 0; i < w.pool; i++ {
274			w.wg.Add(1)
275			go func(id int) {
276				defer w.wg.Done()
277				w.runLoop(ctx, id)
278			}(i)
279		}
280	
281		// Wait for cancellation.
282		<-ctx.Done()
283		w.wg.Wait()
284		return ctx.Err()
285	}
286	
287	func (w *Worker) runLoop(ctx context.Context, id int) {
288		w.log.Debug("worker thread online", zap.Int("thread", id))
289	
290		for {
291			cmd, ack, err := w.consumer.Recv(ctx)
292			if err != nil {
293				if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
294					w.log.Warn("consumer closed, exiting thread", zap.Int("thread", id))
295					return
296				}
297				if ctx.Err() != nil {
298					return
299				}
300				w.log.Error("failed to receive message", zap.Error(err))
301				continue
302			}
303	
304			if err := w.handle(ctx, cmd); err != nil {
305				w.log.Error("command failed", zap.String("commandID", cmd.ID), zap.Error(err))
306				_ = ack(false)
307				continue
308			}
309			_ = ack(true)
310		}
311	}
312	
313	func (w *Worker) handle(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeployCommand) error {
314		strategy := w.strategies[cmd.Tactic]
315		if strategy == nil {
316			return errors.New("no strategy for tactic: " + cmd.Tactic)
317		}
318	
319		w.log.Info("processing command",
320			zap.String("id", cmd.ID),
321			zap.String("app", cmd.App),
322			zap.String("version", cmd.Version),
323			zap.String("tactic", cmd.Tactic),
324		)
325	
326		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Minute)
327		defer cancel()
328	
329		return strategy.Execute(ctx, cmd)
330	}

336	func newLogger(level string) (*zap.Logger, error) {

348			cfg.Level = zap.NewAtomicLevelAt(zap.InfoLevel)
349		}
350		return cfg.Build()
351	}

360		)
361		flag.Parse()
362	
363		cfg, err := loadConfig(*configPath)
364		if err != nil {
365			panic("failed to load config: " + err.Error())
366		}
367	
368		logger, err := newLogger(cfg.LogLevel)
369		if err != nil {
370			panic("failed to init logger: " + err.Error())
371		}
372		defer logger.Sync()
373	
374		// Example: In production wire a Kafka/NATS/SQS consumer here.
375		consumer := NewInMemoryConsumer(100)
376	
377		// For demonstration push a sample message.
378		go func() {
379			sample := &DeployCommand{
380				ID:           "cmd-001",
381				App:          "checkout-service",
382				Version:      "v1.42.0",
383				Tactic:       "bluegreen",
384				TargetGroups: []string{"prod-eu-1"},
385			}
386			b, _ := json.Marshal(sample)
387			logger.Info("publishing sample message", zap.ByteString("payload", b))
388			consumer.stream <- sample

2	// Package event contains the canonical definitions for AutoMESH-Orchestrator’s
3	// event model.  All subsystems—scheduler, agents, metrics collectors,
4	// security scanners, etc.—communicate exclusively by publishing and consuming
5	// Event records defined in this package.
6	//
7	// The guidelines for the event model are:
8	//
9	//   • Immutability:  an Event, once persisted or published, MUST never change.
10	//   • Self-Containment: every Event must carry all information required by any
11	//     downstream consumer to make a decision without additional network hops.
12	//   • Traceability: correlation, causation, and aggregate identifiers MUST be
13	//     populated to enable full distributed-tracing across the serverless mesh.
14	//
15	// The model is intentionally compatible with CNCF CloudEvents v1.0 while
16	// remaining implementation-agnostic, enabling transparent integration with
17	// NATS, Kafka, SNS/SQS, Google Pub/Sub, or any HTTP-based subscription bus.
18	package event
19	
20	import (
21		"encoding/json"
22		"errors"
23		"fmt"
24		"time"
25	
26		"github.com/google/uuid"
27	)
28	
29	// Type represents a canonical event name.
30	//
31	// Use dot-separated, lower-case qualifiers.  The first segment MUST denote a
32	// domain, the second the object, the third the verb.  e.g.:
33	//
34	//	"deploy.requested", "metrics.collected", "security-scan.completed"
35	type Type string
36	
37	const (
38		// Lifecycle events ------------------------------------------------------
39	
40		TypeDeployRequested           Type = "deploy.requested"
41		TypeDeployCompleted           Type = "deploy.completed"
42		TypePatchRequested            Type = "patch.requested"
43		TypePatchCompleted            Type = "patch.completed"
44		TypeScaleRequested            Type = "scale.requested"
45		TypeScaleCompleted            Type = "scale.completed"
46		TypeSecurityScanRequested     Type = "security-scan.requested"
47		TypeSecurityScanCompleted     Type = "security-scan.completed"
48		TypeBackupRequested           Type = "backup.requested"
49		TypeBackupCompleted           Type = "backup.completed"
50		TypeRestoreRequested          Type = "restore.requested"
51		TypeRestoreCompleted          Type = "restore.completed"
52		TypeMetricsCollected          Type = "metrics.collected"
53		TypeAlertTriggered            Type = "alert.triggered"
54		TypeInfrastructureStateChange Type = "infrastructure.state-change"
55	)

60		HeaderPriority      = "x-priority"        // queue priority (0-9)
61		HeaderRetries       = "x-retries"         // delivery attempts counter

63		HeaderContentDigest = "x-content-digest"  // sha256 of Data
64	)

66	// Version denotes the schema version of Event. Increment on backward-incompatible
67	// changes.  Helpers reject payloads that do not match supported versions.
68	const Version = 1

70	// Event is the core envelope transported via message buses and persisted to the
71	// event store.  The struct purposefully resembles CNCF CloudEvents yet stays
72	// minimal for performance on high-throughput serverless fabrics.
73	type Event struct {
74		// ID is a globally unique, immutable identifier.
75		ID string `json:"id,omitempty"`
76	
77		// Type classifies the event (e.g., "deploy.requested").
78		Type Type `json:"type"`
79	
80		// Version designates the schema version for this envelope.
81		Version int `json:"version"`
82	
83		// Source is the canonical URI or opaque string that produced the event.
84		Source string `json:"source"`
85	
86		// Timestamp when the event occurred in RFC 3339 format.
87		Timestamp time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
88	
89		// CorrelationID links events that belong to the same logical transaction.
90		CorrelationID string `json:"correlation_id,omitempty"`
91	
92		// CausationID references the event that triggered this event (if any).
93		CausationID string `json:"causation_id,omitempty"`
94	
95		// AggregateID groups events that mutate the same logical aggregate,
96		// enabling stream replay (e.g., a deployment or cluster identifier).
97		AggregateID string `json:"aggregate_id,omitempty"`
98	
99		// Data holds the immutable, JSON-encoded business payload.
100		Data json.RawMessage `json:"data,omitempty"`
101	
102		// Headers carry supplementary, non-business metadata.
103		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers,omitempty"`
104	}

106	// New returns a fully populated Event envelope.
107	//
108	// Example:
109	//
110	//	payload := DeployRequest{/* ... */}
111	//	ev, err := event.New(event.TypeDeployRequested, "autoscheduler", payload,
112	//		event.WithAggregateID("cluster-123"),
113	//		event.WithCorrelationID("op-456"))
114	func New(eventType Type, source string, payload any, opts ...Option) (Event, error) {
115		if eventType == "" {
116			return Event{}, errors.New("event: type cannot be empty")
117		}
118		if source == "" {
119			return Event{}, errors.New("event: source cannot be empty")

123		if err != nil {

125		}

128			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
129			Type:      eventType,
130			Version:   Version,
131			Source:    source,
132			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
133			Data:      raw,
134			Headers:   make(map[string]string),
135		}
136	
137		for _, opt := range opts {
138			if err := opt(&e); err != nil {

140			}

143	}

156		}
157	}

92			}

152		results, err := c.metrics.Evaluate(ctx, plan.Metadata.ServiceName, plan.Canary.MetricThresholds)

163			if r > max {
164				return false, fmt.Sprintf("metric %s exceeded threshold %.3f > %.3f", name, r, max)
165			}
